27/27 pass. The responsibility split is now clean:

**`BracketValidator`** owns algorithm orchestration — creating `ValidationContext`, driving the `IntStream` loop, calling `checkComplete()`. It takes a `BracketConfig` at construction time, so it's reusable across multiple `validate` calls with the same configuration. `IntStream` moves here from `BalancedParentheses`.

**`BalancedParentheses`** owns only the public API surface — the default validator (a single static instance), the exception-to-boolean conversion in `isBalanced`, and the `Map`-to-`BracketConfig` conversion at the boundary. It no longer knows anything about `ValidationContext`, `BracketMatcher`, or stream processing. The `IntStream` import drops out of it entirely.

`DEFAULT_VALIDATOR` replaces the separate `DEFAULT_CONFIG` field — one static object rather than two, since the config exists only to construct the validator anyway.
